description: Four 8-step trigger sequencers on one panel, each with its own clock, run and reset, and each driving two trigger outputs

params.text: Sets how many of the eight steps that channel plays, from 1 to 8; the small green lights beside the step numbers show the length in use
Holds that output at 0V while it is on, leaving the rest of the channel running
Switches that step on or off for that output; with the step on, the output pulses when the step comes round

inputs.text: A gate above 2V lets that channel run and a level below 0.1V pauses it, play resuming at the next clock; with nothing patched, a channel takes the run signal of the one before it and channel 1 runs
Each rising edge above 2V moves that channel on one step, and the time it stays high sets the length of its trigger pulses; unpatched, a channel takes the clock of the one before it
A rising edge above 2V restarts that channel at step one on the next clock, or at once if it lands within 100uS of a clock edge; with nothing patched, a channel takes the reset of the one before it
Sets how many steps that channel plays, 0V giving one step and 10V all eight, and disables the LENGTH knob for that channel while patched; these jacks are not normalled

outputs.text: Pulses to 10V on each step switched on for that output, for as long as the clock input is high

notes: the Trigger Sequencer Gate Expander placed immediately to the right adds two gate outputs per channel, held high for the whole step rather than for the clock pulse
menu: Channel 1, Channel 2, Channel 3 and Channel 4 — each leads to Initialize and Randomize for that channel, acting on Entire Channel, A Triggers Only or B Triggers Only
Add gate expander — places a Trigger Sequencer Gate Expander immediately to the right of this module
Add CV expander — places a Sequencer CV Expander to the right of this module
Add output expander — places a Sequencer Output Expander to the right of this module
Add trigger expander — places a Sequencer Trigger Expander to the right of this module
Add random melody expander — places a Gated Comparator Random Melody expander to the right of this module
Add logic expander — places a Gated Comparator Gate Logic expander to the right of this module
